critical_code_review_comments: Login.js L107-119 — restore-pending block is wrapped in try/catch with TTL guard (Date.now()<j.until). Safe, idempotent, mobile-friendly. Good.
Login.js L226-232 — ?reason=session_expired branch now ONLY strips the URL (no toast). Matches iter64 spec verbatim.

Login.js L362-370 — on 202, JSON.stringify({request_id, email, until: now+15min}) into localStorage. The 15-min TTL matches backend session_requests TTL (server.py L1297), so client-side flag will not outlive the server-side request.
Login.js L158, L199, L204, L193 — localStorage flag cleared on all terminal polling outcomes (approved/denied/expired) + on post-approval /auth/me failure. No leak.
AuthContext.js L67-75 — 401 interceptor parses localStorage safely (try/catch), checks until>Date.now() and self-cleans stale entries. Correct.

IdeasButton.jsx L36-52 — useState lazy-init from localStorage with merge-default {bug:true,idea:true,other:true,...JSON.parse} prevents partial-state corruption if user upgrades from a future schema with fewer kinds.
IdeasButton.jsx L54-60 — visibleIdeas memo properly chains filter then sort; default kind 'idea' when missing; preserves chronological order within each kind group when sortByKind on.
server.py 7538 lines — STILL strongly recommend splitting routers (auth/devices/accounts/ideas) — carried over from iter63 review.

Pre-existing data-hygiene: test_iter62_device_capture.py::test_full_flow_register_verify_login is NOT idempotent — registers user with hardcoded pseudo 'regr62' so re-runs without prior cleanup hit a Mongo unique-index DuplicateKeyError on pseudo_lower. Test data should use a timestamped pseudo OR the test should cleanup after itself. Not iter64-introduced.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iter64 implementation. The user-reported 'Ta session a expiré' mobile toast issue is conclusively resolved at two layers: (a) Login.js no longer SHOWS the toast at all on ?reason=session_expired (just strips the URL), and (b) AuthContext.js 401 interceptor still respects the localStorage pendingApproval flag (with TTL) to suppress the redirect-and-toast cycle while an approval is in flight.
